scope: G-88 items 4 and 5, kit side only. Item 5's DesignSync re-sync half is the planner's and is NOT in this close.
missionPremise: G-88 item 2 shipped four CSS families into the product's web/shell.css and merged at 6a4580d, and the kit still vendored the pre-merge copy. Its SHIPPED.size === 109 pin therefore still passed, on a stale file. That is a gate being lied to rather than a gate holding, and the whole row exists to make the coverage claim true against the bigger denominator instead of true against an old one. Source: the approved WDLL card _inbox/2026-08-18_g88_design_into_apps_WDLL.md items 4 and 5, the families investigation _inbox/2026-08-18_g88_css_families_investigation.md (operator rulings G1, G2, G6), and the translation-boundary investigation _inbox/2026-08-18_g88_translation_boundary.md, whose stated position is that the denominator is RECOUNTED and never forecast.
completionPredicate: A stranger can verify this without the executor. Clone smartcity-kit at PR #7's head, run `npm run refresh:vendor <a smartcity-dashboards checkout at 6a4580d>` and see zero files change. Run `node -e` over stylesheetClasses() and get 139. Run `SC_DASHBOARDS_DIR=<that checkout> npm test` and get 81 of 81 with nothing skipped, including the coverage assertion that every one of the 139 classes is emitted by a component. Run `npm run prove:gates` and see 30 of 30 injections fire and name their file plus 1 of 1 control stay green. Read test/gate3-classes.test.mjs and find the coverage assertion unweakened, with no exclusion set and no class parked as structural. The CI check-run conclusion string on the head SHA is "success".
scopeBasis: The dispatch drew the boundary at a green PR that makes the bundle correct to build, and stopped short of the DesignSync upload and the merge, both of which are planner-owned. Inside that boundary the executable question was which classes get wrapped, and the answer is all thirty with no exclusion set, because the dispatch named that explicitly as the failure mode to avoid. Three things were deliberately excluded rather than forgotten. vendor/sc-kit.css was not touched, because it is byte-identical across three repos and a token change there is a product-line decision, not a kit PR. No markup-parity case was added for any of the nine new components, because the product ships zero markup for these thirty classes and a parity case needs a real product counterpart to compare against; every new gallery entry's `from` says so in words rather than naming a screen that does not exist. The product-side counting-rule hardening (WDLL item 3) and the divergence test that would prove the kit's rule and the product's rule return identical sets are product-repo work and are not touched here. One thing was included beyond the literal ask and is named rather than buried: harness/render-harness.mjs gained a fifth gallery page, because its own comment says the split exists so a screenshot stays legible and part 4 would otherwise have carried 22 entries into a fixed-height screenshot.

threeInversionTraps.trap1_licensedBodySlot: ADDRESSED. ModelCite is a separate component and removes children from its prop bag. Held by a law test asserting the Omit is in source and asserting the exact rendered output, by a consumer MUST_NOT_COMPILE case watched rejecting a body on the offending line, and by a prove:gates injection that restores the children slot and watches the law test fire.
threeInversionTraps.trap2_invertedApplicability: ADDRESSED. MatrixRow has no default applicability. Held by a law test asserting no default exists in source, a law test asserting the four values map to the four state classes AND that the pass arm renders no carrier beyond mx-pass, a consumer MUST_NOT_COMPILE case for a row that omits it, and a prove:gates injection that adds a `pass` default and watches the law test fire. The prove:gates needle was tightened from the bare word `applicability` to the printed regex of the doesNotMatch assertion, because the bare word appears in that suite for a dozen reasons and a loose needle would score an unrelated failure as this gate working.
threeInversionTraps.trap3_bareConfidence: ADDRESSED. No Meter is exported and no confidence prop exists on any other component, so the only way to draw a meter is BasisLine, which requires a source count and a timestamp. Confidence is one object carrying its state so a level cannot be given stateless. Finding takes the basis line's props and constructs it. A node-typed slot was considered and rejected because a JSX expression is ReactElement<any> under these React types, which would have made the slot type decorative. Held by two law tests, two consumer MUST_NOT_COMPILE cases, and a prove:gates injection that removes the timestamp slot and watches the law test fire.
